* Internal representation of map fields in generated lite-runtime messages. * *

This class is a protobuf implementation detail. Users shouldn't use this class directly.

methods.name: public static MapFieldLite<K, V> emptyMapField()
methods.comment: Returns a singleton immutable empty MapFieldLite instance.

methods.comment:
* Checks whether two {@link Map}s are equal. We don't use the default equals method of {@link
   * Map} because it compares by identity not by content for byte arrays.

methods.name: public boolean equals(Object object)
methods.comment: Checks whether two map fields are equal.

methods.name: static int calculateHashCodeForMap(Map<K, V> a)
methods.comment:
* Calculates the hash code for a {@link Map}. We don't use the default hash code method of {@link
   * Map} because for byte arrays and protobuf enums it use {@link Object#hashCode()}.

methods.name: static Map<K, V> copy(Map<K, V> map)
methods.comment:
* Makes a deep copy of a {@link Map}. Immutable objects in the map will be shared (e.g.,
   * integers, strings, immutable messages) and mutable ones will have a copy (e.g., byte arrays,
   * mutable messages).

methods.name: public MapFieldLite<K, V> mutableCopy()
methods.comment: Returns a deep copy of this map field.

methods.name: public void makeImmutable()
methods.comment:
* Makes this field immutable. All subsequent modifications will throw an {@link
   * UnsupportedOperationException}.

methods.name: public boolean isMutable()
methods.comment: Returns whether this field can be modified.
